messages.text:
The iPhone is yours now, booked for you from 15:42Z for 15 min (until 15:57Z); no agent will touch it.
- Nobody was using it, so there was no wait; the v10 phone check waits until you are done.
- The GPU-morph Try-it pages from the GPU-morph proposal (PR-030) are still served for the phone, if you want to try them.
What you need to do: use the phone, then write "done" here so I release it (I'll extend the booking if you need longer).

Released: the iPhone is no longer booked for you, as of 15:47Z.
- The v10 phone check (today's page vs v10, about 45 min) takes it next.
What you need to do: please keep off the phone during that check.

Great news, thank you: the GPU-morph version (PR-030) goes into the v10 best build, as you decided at 15:49Z.
- I stopped the v10 phone check that had just started: it measured v10 without the GPU-morph version, so its numbers would not describe your build.
- The v10 builder (int-v8) now adds the GPU-morph version on top, with its author (arch-compositor-morph) helping where the two touch the same end-of-page code.
- Then the new v10 gets its pixel check, Simulator counts and the phone no-worse check, then your finger test.
- Still open for you: the fade-pause revision 3 (PR-029), which sits on top of the GPU-morph version; decide it when you like.
- Next for the GPU-morph author: the 3-6 slow frames still at the very end of the page.
What you need to do: nothing now; I'll post the new v10's time here.

The new v10 (with the GPU-morph version) should be ready for your finger test at about 18:15Z.
| Step | Expected done |
|---|---|
| Build v10 + GPU-morph, check the code matches | about 16:30Z |
| Pixel check and Simulator work counts | about 17:30Z |
| Phone no-worse check (about 45 min) | about 18:15Z |
- The stopped phone check had recorded no runs, so nothing was lost; the phone is free until about 17:30Z.
What you need to do: nothing now; the finger test comes to you as a console step.
